title: Analytical Modeling and Optimal GPU Provisioning for Disaggregated LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.28760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present OSplit, an exact analytical method that enables efficient partitioning of a GPU L1 domain into prefill and decode workers, including sharding for classical and advanced GPUs. OSplit takes into consideration model parameters, enabling any inference model to be partitioned into prefill and decode workers with a goal of producing the maximum throughput possible. OSplit is based on a capacity model that takes as inputs the model, the loading scheme (batch size, max sequence length), and models an inference serving framework (vLLM) and computes the efficiency of each GPU. For this, we model H100 and GB300 GPUs, and model a scale-up domain, along with FlashAttention-based kernels. OSplit first computes an optimal collective generation policy, which gives inputs to the capacity model that enables optimal split of prefill and decode GPUs. translated_title: 分离式大语言模型推理的解析建模与最优GPU配置
translated_abstract: 我们提出了OSplit，一种精确的解析方法，能够将GPU L1域高效地划分为预填充和解码工作节点，包括对经典和先进GPU进行分片。OSplit考虑了模型参数，使任何推理模型都能被划分为预填充和解码工作节点，目标是产生最大可能的吞吐量。OSplit基于一个容量模型，该模型以模型本身和加载方案（批大小、最大序列长度）作为输入，对推理服务框架进行建模，并计算每个GPU的效率。为此，我们对H100和GB300 GPU进行建模，并建模了一个纵向扩展域以及基于FlashAttention的内核。OSplit首先计算最优的集体生成策略，为容量模型提供输入，从而实现预填充GPU和解码GPU的最优划分。我们使用vLLM推理服务在H100 (NVL8)和GB300 (NVL72)上评估了我们的方案。
tldr: OSplit是一种精确的解析建模方法，可基于容量模型将GPU资源最优地划分为预填充和解码工作节点，从而最大化分离式大语言模型推理的吞吐量。
en_tdlr: OSplit is an exact analytical modeling method that leverages a capacity model to optimally partition GPUs into prefill and decode workers, maximizing throughput for disaggregated LLM inference.
